name: qfd_slab_pg_col_mgc-c5c-81025983b
purpose: q13-coll root cause of the residual M4 DRC at macro E edges (ct1-ct5 / slab c1-c4): VIA45 dropped from an M5 track over the macro interior next to a 24 nm M4 edge pin; its M4 landing sits 13-53 nm from (or crosses) the wide M4 OBS that ends 72 nm inside the edge. Physical fix: temporary M5 route keepout over the macro pin-edge band (created pre-GRT, removed post-DRT, asserted count) so every macro pin is entered planar on its own M4 track from the channel; LEF OBS, M5 cap, SDC unchanged. Variant c: M5 keepout over the whole ROM macro; c4 kit otherwise.
